avis.titre: balm that actually keeps my skin hydrated
avis.texte: Honestly, this surprised me more than I expected. I mainly tried it on my lips and dry areas around my face, and it leaves the skin feeling really soft and hydrated without that sticky feeling some balms have. It also melts into the skin pretty fast, which I liked a lot. The glow it gives looks healthy instead of greasy, and the fact that it works for lips, face, and body makes it super practical. One thing I didn't love is the size. Since it's only 15 ml, I feel like it could run out pretty quickly if you use it every day. Also, if you apply too much on oily skin, it can feel a little heavy. But overall, it's a really convenient product to keep in your bag for quick hydration throughout the day. Gifted by L.A. Girl

Gifted by Lagirl ✨ really impressed me. It has a smooth, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly and leaves the skin feeling soft and hydrated without any heavy or greasy feel. I love how versatile it is — it helps nourish and soothe while giving the skin a healthy, comfortable finish. Perfect for days when you want something simple, effective, and multi-purpose. Definitely worth trying.
Perfect for hydrating dry areas of your skin. Did moisturize my lips well. Not so much a cleanser.
This is perfect after using the cleansing balm. My face is makeup free and squeaky clean. 10/10!!!!

My skin gets soo dry during the winter, and this has been amazing to combat that. I've been putting it on my extra dry spots (under my nose, on my hands, and on my elbows) and it immediately provides relief to the discomfort of dry patches of skin.

I love how versatile this balm is! A little goes a long way on lips, cuticles and even dry patches. The blend of olive oil, chia seed oil and cocoa butter makes it incredibly hydrating without feeling greasy. It absorbs quickly, leaves a healthy glow, and the scent is subtle and pleasant. Perfect for travel or tossing in my bag.

I'm an East Coast girl and it's winter here! This Pro Balm is a dry skin saver - today in a pinch I reached for it to moisturize my lips and boy was I pleasantly surprised! A little, tiny bit goes a long way! My lips instantly felt luxurious and the little extra I had on my finger I went ahead and gave my cuticles some extra moisturizing! A must have in your handbag(or your dress with pockets 🤗) Definitely a "multitasker" !
